title: d23-harness overlay test reads the working tree, not HEAD, so uncommitted deletions do not redden fast
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 S1: fast failed test/evals/d23-harness.test.ts ENOENT scripts/claude/capability-index.ts because overlayFiles reads HEAD while the file was deleted in the worktree; passed after commit.
Outcome: the overlay walk skips files absent from the working tree or lists from the index.
Proof: node --test test/evals/d23-harness.test.ts passes with a staged deletion.
